name: Snake draft
use_when: people take turns choosing from a shared board until it is split up: trip itinerary, who plans which activity, chores picked in turn, rooms by draft order
'snake draft', 'draft order', 'take turns picking', 'first pick', 'we each pick one then go back'
everyone ends up owning some of the options, and the order should be fair and random
dont_use_when: Muse hands tasks out at random with a spin (use assign)
people grab what they want, first come first served (use claims)
the group picks one winner (use poll, wheel or veto)
fixed seats or beds with no turn order (use slots)
guarantees: Start draws the turn order from the server seed, the same for everyone, shown only once confirmed
the order snakes: 1 2 3, then 3 2 1; only the person up can pick, one free option per turn
each option is picked once; nobody gets more picks than the rounds allow
someone who joins mid-draft enters at the next round; a leaver's picks go back on the board and the next person is up

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Nashville: who plans what'

options.description: Options on the board from the chat, 2 to 12, short

rounds.description: Picks per person, 1 to 6; 0 to go until the board is empty

people.description: Names of the people drafting, as in the chat; empty for everyone in the chat
